contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. As or Dupondius of Faustina II (147-175), as kindly identified by the finder, mint of Rome. Obverse description: Bust coiffed with bun and draped right. Obverse inscription: [FAVSTI]NA AVGVSTA. Reverse description: Female figure draped standing left with left arm extended and right arm raised; objects appear hanging from elbows. S C in field. Reverse inscription: [---]N[---].…
